subject: maths
question: A large spherical marble of radius R is melted down and recast into n smaller spherical marbles of radius r. Determine the value of n.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of large spherical marble = R

Radius of each small spherical marble = r

Number of small marbles formed = n

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

Total volume before melting = Total volume after recasting

**Calculation:**

Volume of large sphere

⇒ (4/3) × π × R³

Volume of one small sphere

⇒ (4/3) × π × r³

Total volume of n small spheres

⇒ n × (4/3) × π × r³

Since volume is conserved

⇒ (4/3) × π × R³ = n × (4/3) × π × r³

Cancel common terms (4/3) and π

⇒ R³ = n × r³

⇒ n = R³ / r³

⇒ n = (R / r)³

**∴ The number of small spherical marbles formed is (R / r)³.**
